_readme: Human-in-the-loop layer for the updates feed. Always wins over the auto-filter.
pinned: ordered update ids shown in the 'Pinned' rail above the feed.
hidden: update ids to drop entirely (off-topic, superseded, low value).
notes: id -> your own one-line take, shown under the headline. ORIGINAL WORDS ONLY — never paste AWS's copy.
Find an id by looking at data/updates.json, or hover any card on /updates.
This file is never overwritten by the refresh job. See CURATION.md.
